Nov. 16EQT Completes Platinum Investment Management AcquisitionMT Nov. 15EQT Holdings Limited completed the acquisition of Platinum Investment Management Limited from Platinum Asset Pty Limited.CI

EQT Holdings Limited (ASX:EQT) entered into a conditional share sale and purchase agreement to acquire Platinum Investment Management Limited from Platinum Asset Pty Limited on October 12, 2026. The sale of Platinum Investment Management Limited to EQT (Transaction) forms part of the ongoing integration work following the merger of Platinum Asset Management and L1 Capital, which completed on 1 October 2025. PIML will remain the responsible entity of relevant Platinum funds, including the Platinum International Fund Complex ETF (ASX:PIXX), the Platinum Asia Fund Complex ETF (ASX:PAXX) and other unlisted Platinum funds (PIML Funds), once it is part of the EQT Group. It is then intended that the responsible entity of each of the PIML Funds will be changed to another entity within the EQT Group. Any change of responsible entity will be subject to regulatory requirements. Investors will be notified before any change takes effect. The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee. EQT Holdings Limited (ASX:EQT) completed the acquisition of Platinum Investment Management Limited from Platinum Asset Pty Limited on November 16, 2026.

EQT Holdings Limited is an independent trustee and executor company. The Companyâ€™s segments include Trustee & Wealth Services and Corporate & Superannuation Trustee Services. The Trustee & Wealth Services segment is a private client business, providing a range of personal and community trustee services, which includes estate planning and management, trust services for individuals, health and personal injury clients, and charitable and community trusts. The Trustee & Wealth Services segment operates within Australia. The Corporate & Superannuation Trustee Services (CSTS) segment provides a range of global fiduciary services for managed investment schemes on behalf of local and international fund managers and sponsors, as well as specialized trustee services for debt, securitizations, custody and real estate arrangements for corporates. It also provides trustee, custody, and investment management services for superannuation funds. The CSTS operates within Australia.
